rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, 2004).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses as 'Artista Panarosa'.
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 2019 as 'Maurice Utrillo'.
rows.Bloom: Red and white, yellow center, stripes. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
